data.title: Westinghouse eVinci™ Microreactor Achieves Zero-Power High-Temperature Criticality
data.description: Westinghouse Electric Company, based in Cranberry Township, Pennsylvania, has achieved a significant milestone by successfully conducting zero-power high-temperature criticality testing for its eVinci™ microreactor. This marks a crucial step in the program's development process. The testing was carried out in collaboration with Los Alamos National Laboratory and the Nevada National Security Site at the National Criticality Experiments Research Center. This Center, a capability of the National Nuclear Security Administration, played a key role in this achievement. This successful testing demonstrates the progress made in advancing the eVinci™ microreactor technology.

data.title: New Flyer awarded contract for up to 45 Xcelsior® CNG articulated buses from Central Ohio Transit Authority
data.description: On September 15, 2026, in St. Cloud, Minnesota, NFI Group Inc. (NFI), a prominent bus and motorcoach manufacturer, along with its subsidiary New Flyer of America Inc. data.title: ZenaTech Closes 29th Drone as a Service Acquisition Adding Solar and Railroad Customers with Georgia-based U.S. Land Surveying Company Holding Licenses in 17 States
data.description: In Vancouver, British Columbia, on September 15, 2026, technology solutions provider ZenaTech, Inc. (Nasdaq: ZENA) (FSE: 49Q) (BMV: ZENA) announced the successful acquisition of Merritt Paul Land Surveying, LLC, a Franklin, Georgia-based land surveying firm. Merritt Paul, established in 2015, is known for its surveying services in the solar, transportation, and construction sectors, with notable projects for a leading national transportation firm and a focus on utility-scale solar surveys nationwide. The company holds licenses for land surveys in 17 states. This acquisition represents ZenaTech's 29th acquisition in the Drone as a Service sector.

data.title: Knight Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Submission of GEMTESA® in Canada
data.description: Montreal, September 15, 2026 - Knight Therapeutics Inc. ("Knight") (TSX: GUD), a leading pan-American (ex-US) pharmaceutical company, revealed today that Health Canada has approved Knight's New Drug Submission (NDS) for GEMTESA ® (vibegron). This medication is intended for treating overactive bladder (OAB) in adults, addressing symptoms like urge urinary incontinence, urgency, and urinary frequency. For adult males undergoing pharmacological therapy for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH), GEMTESA ® is also proposed to manage OAB with symptoms of urge urinary incontinence, urgency, urinary frequency, and nocturia. This development marks a significant milestone for Knight in the pharmaceutical sector.

data.description: A recent report reveals that the global carbon dioxide emissions have reached record levels in 2021, totaling over 34.5 billion metric tons.
